Source: Figma version 2412078996349254008. Queue: [build-queue.md](build-queue.md).

A component is every section sharing a component name (override name, then inventory proposed name, then vision name, else the cluster id). Each instance gets a variant key from visual traits a designer would style: background colour family, text alignment, media side (reversed), image layout (0, 1, 2, 3 or more) and height class (compact or tall only beyond 1.5x the component median). Optional text elements (eyebrow, button, caption) and heading size swaps are content, listed per component, not variants. Same key and same text content: a duplicate (build once, reuse). Same key, different content: one variant with different content (props or CMS fields). Different keys: variants, built as `is-` modifiers on one component (CLAUDE.md, Component Variants). Labels describe how a variant differs from the base (the most common variant).

## Merged near-identical components

Vision reviewers named sections independently, so one block can carry two names. Score = 0.4 x structural link (exact shared inventory cluster 1, loose cluster only 0.4, none 0) + 0.6 x spec feature similarity (roles 0.3, layout 0.2, alignment 0.15, images 0.15, height 0.1, background 0.1; each variant matched to its best counterpart). Pairs at or above 0.79 merge into the name with more instances; the other name becomes an alias and its instances become variants. Constants: `SIMILARITY` in `scripts/api/figma/lib/queue.mjs`.
